notes.title: v5 Afterlife OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Summon minions and evolve them into 73 types[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gJKgOrL.png[/img]

[h2]Build up a massive team of up to 180 minions, with dozens of combos and strategies![/h2]

[h2]Fight Bosses and buy Vending Machine Items[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6Kb0itU.png[/img]


[h2][b]New Endgame:[/b] Enter the LORDS LAIR and light the 4 torches[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/q0ueYcU.png[/img]

Thank you everyone for playing my game, I'm so happy to finally bring you this update after almost 3 years -- I actually thought of this concept of ruling over an army of minions and hopping from realm to realm building up your army way back in 2020, so I'm really excited to see what you all think of it!

Lots of love, kisses, hugs, uhhh smooches and a tinge of weird old-person perfume since I'm ending this post like a boomer,

Lavaflame2 ːreheartː

notes.title: Future content, bug fixes, cloudsave and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, just a few things I want to announce:

[h2]Idle Skilling's next major update, the Afterlife, is coming [u][b]October 21st[/b][/u][/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sAW54ni.png[/img]

[h2]In order to access the Afterlife, you'll need to reach PURGATORY. That's the 6th fighting zone in the game.[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TETN5Pt.png[/img]


Along with that, I have added a dedicated [b]Steam Cloudsave button[/b], which you can find in the gym area. I heard a lot of feedback from you, the players, toward how confusing the previous cloudsaving system was, so I hope this change helps!

Further, I have also fixed many of the most reported bugs, including various minor details being lost between cloudsaving (like having to re-find secrets, having to re-assign crusaders, having to re-assign spelunkers, and a few other things).

I hope you've all been having a blast going through the game
